Name: Kenneth's Dessert Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Dessert Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds 30+ desserts to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Cupcakes like Blueberry Frosted Cupcake, Purple Frosted Cupcake[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Pies like Chocolate Berry Pie Slice, Spiced Pumpkin Pie, Plain Crustless Pie Shell[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Cookies like Strawberry Cream Cookie, Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookie, Chewy Carob Cookie[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Doughnuts like Pink Sprinkle Doughnut, Pink Sprinkled Doughnut[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Ice Cream like Cherry Chocolate Sundae Cup, Chocolate Coated Ice Cream Bar, Chocolate Ice Cream Sandwich, Oreo Style Ice Cream Sandwich, Strawberry Milkshake with Cherry, Trio Sundae Glass[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Popsicles like Orange Vanilla Popsicle Bar, Red Cherry Popsicle, Red White Blue Rocket Pop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Snow Cones like Strawberry Red Snow Cone, Orange Mango Snow Cone, Green Apple Snow Cone, Blue Raspberry Snow Cone, Grape Purple Snow Cone, Rainbow Swirl Snow Cone[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Candy like Green Lime Gelatin, Black Licorice Stick, Fried Banana Fritters, Birch Bark Wrapped Candy, Wobbly Vanilla Flummery[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All items have cooking recipes that use ingredients from Grocery Store and Fruit Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Every recipe can be turned on or off in GMCM[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All items are sold in Kenneth's Dessert Shop building. The building has 5 shops inside with different selections.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Grocery Store - for recipe ingredients[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Fruit Shop - for some recipe ingredients[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for toggling recipes[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Full requirements list is shown in the Requirements tab above.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Install all required mods listed above[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
